title: More ways to build with Pollinations
summary:
Community projects filled the catalog while Build Diary loading, model routes, and GitHub username sync got repairs.

Fourteen catalog updates added community projects spanning novel writing, interactive stories, games, dataset tools, desktop assistants, and chat bots. Among them: House Painter visualizes exterior color schemes, Alchemica invents element combinations, and NEURGenerator brings the API to ESP32-S3 hardware.

Build Diary changes fixed entry loading that could freeze the page, corrected broken daily images and stale weekly paths, and standardized how daily and weekly summaries are read. Weekly entries now use the Sunday publish date for the preceding week.

Nano Banana was moved from a preview image model to the stable `gemini-2.5-flash-image` model ahead of the preview’s scheduled March 19 retirement. Qwen3.5 397B and its aliases were removed from the registry after requests through Fireworks serverless failed.
